st_player_rating_reliability.description: Special-teams APM odd/even-week split-half reliability, n=996 players with 50+ plays per half, 2019-2024 ST plays
st_player_rating_reliability.notes: Predeclared docs/st_player_ratings.md. Split-half Pearson +0.2791 Spearman +0.2761 SB +0.4364. Token-vs-play_type agreement 96.2%. 14686 ST plays (FG 4597 KO 4704 PUNT 4560 other 825), 3020 rated participants. Single pooled coefficient per player across ST units by design. No ATS read (rotation pools exhausted).
st_player_rating_reliability.plain_summary: Special-teams players show a real but modest repeatable effect from week to week, so a special-teams rating is worth building later; nothing is proven about picking winners.
